title: ConformanceClaim
$comment: A claim is scoped to the classes, profiles, and pins it names. Silence claims nothing (§1.5). AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

classes.description: A claim MUST NOT name a class whose suite did not pass in full (§1.5, T-P15-3).

items.description: Resolution profile identifier (§9). A release claiming the `document` extension (§16.5) widens this enum.

pins.description: The pinned revisions tested against; MUST equal §1.6’s (T-P9-1, T-P9-2).

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

limitations.description: Path to the LIMITATIONS document (§15.4, T-P15-2).
